only_change: Subtract 0.5 frozen entry-time bands from every original stepped profit watermark, including the initial floor
activation: Strictly greater than +1 frozen entry-time band; unchanged
profit_floor_steps: 0.5 bands at activation; 1.5 at +2 bands; 2.5 at +3 bands; never retreat
exit: First observed trade strictly below signed profit floor; original priority and gap handling unchanged
unchanged: First reversal after qualified overshoot entry
cost_assumption: Illustrative all-in deductions, not reconstructed executable bid/ask fills
